verdict.rationale: MailerSend publishes a broad, documented public REST API under developers.mailersend.com. It covers async email sending with status querying, webhooks, templates CRUD, SMS, WhatsApp, email verification, scheduled messages and account limits, backed by official client libraries and an llms.txt index. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: This endpoint allows you to send an asynchronous email.
It returns the status of the email sent with an `x-message-id` that can be used to continuously query for the status using the Email API.
Create, fetch, update, and delete single templates or a list of templates.
Get your account's plan, email usage, API rate limits and resource limits in one request.
MailerSend supports this list of official libraries for your favorite programming language. This is the easiest way to integrate MailerSend with your application.
